caption: The drawing is done in shades of black, white, and gray, depicting a bonnet as the central object. The bonnet features quilted detailing on the front brim, a smoothly gathered cap, and a large ribbon tied in a bow at the neck, with two ribbon strands hanging down. The bonnet is rendered with shading to show texture and folds. Above the main bonnet, there is a smaller rectangular inset showing a simplified, top-down or back view of the same style of bonnet, illustrating its circular crown and attached ribbons. Both images are enclosed in thin, straight-lined rectangles. Below the larger rectangle, the name “ANNGENE BUCKLEY” is printed in bold, black, stylized, all-capital letters. The background is plain and off-white, and the composition is centered on the page.
title: Bonnet
